column7: 2026-11-04: Payroll build: a quarter token is planned as a separate change (not yet added). Quarters are Australian financial-year quarters: year starts 1 July, so Jul-Sep is Q1, Oct-Dec Q2, Jan-Mar Q3, Apr-Jun Q4. User said not to add it with the {MMM} change.

2026-11-04: Grants build: a quarter token is wanted later (NOT added yet, user said only weekday names today). Grants use the US federal fiscal year, starting 1 October: Oct-Dec is Q1, Jan-Mar Q2, Apr-Jun Q3, Jul-Sep Q4. This differs from the payroll branch (Australian FY, starts 1 July), so don't copy that mapping. {ddd} short weekday and {MMM} short month were added on this branch.
